-- One step of a linear congruential generator.
-- The state stays in [0, 2^31), so the product stays under 2^63 and cannot overflow.
next_state(s: int) -> int =
  pre s >= 0
  pre s < 2147483648
  post out >= 0
  post out < 2147483648
  ex next_state(0) == 12345
  (s * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648

-- Deterministic shuffle: the result depends only on `xs` and `seed`.
-- It uses no capabilities, so there is no hidden randomness.
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 7) == []
  ex shuffled([5], 3) == [5]
  var r = copy xs
  var s = seed % 2147483648
  var i = r.len() - 1
  while i > 0
    s = next_state(s)
    let j = (s // 65536) % (i + 1)
    let a = r[i]
    let b = r[j]
    r[i] = b
    r[j] = a
    i -= 1
  r
